senses.gloss: m. (פְּגַר I) damage (to a ship); indemnity for shipwreck.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 69b:12">B. Mets. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>ספינתא … אגרא ופ׳</he> when hiring a ship … you must pay rent and indemnity for damage, v. <cite ref="A00339"><he>אַגְרָא</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 70a:1">Ib. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>אגרא … ופ׳ בשעת שבירה</he> the rent must be paid at the time of taking possession, and the indemnity, when the ship is wrecked.
